metadata.description: Product marketing skills for B2B SaaS PMMs and GTM operators: positioning and messaging, ICP and buyer personas, competitive intelligence and battlecards, GTM strategy and launch tiering, OKRs, PRDs, retros, customer stories and a shared company brain for Claude Code and Claude.

plugins.name: pmm-go-to-market
plugins.description: Go-to-market skills for PMMs: beachhead segments, launch tiering and GTM strategy briefs, GTM motions and multi-skill workflow orchestration.

plugins.name: pmm-positioning
plugins.description: Positioning and messaging skills for B2B SaaS PMMs: ICP, alternatives map, buyer personas, market context, brand voice, positioning statements, message house, proof points and messaging playbooks.

plugins.name: pmm-execution
plugins.description: Day-to-day PMM execution skills: PRDs, OKRs, pre-mortems, retros, stakeholder maps, interview summaries, experiment docs and prioritization frameworks.

plugins.name: pmm-growth
plugins.description: Growth skills for PMMs: North Star Metric and scorecard, positioning angles, campaign ideas, value-prop variants and checked customer stories.

plugins.name: pmm-intelligence
plugins.description: A weekly read on what changed around your product: at most five opportunities from signals you name, each tied to your brain and quarterly priorities.

plugins.name: pmm-competitive-intelligence
plugins.description: Competitive intelligence skills for B2B SaaS PMMs: dated competitor profiles, live-deal battlecards, decision-ready deep-dives, a weekly leadership brief and a weekly industry newsletter, with competitor answers your team can get in Slack.

plugins.name: pmm-toolkit
plugins.description: PMM utilities: writing assistant for internal and marketing content, resume review, privacy policy generator and GACCS campaign briefs.

plugins.name: pmm-meta
plugins.description: Meta skills that operate on the skill system itself: skill review, session learning, cross-skill synthesis and output verification.

plugins.name: product-marketing-context
plugins.description: The PMM brain — builds and maintains /foundation/brain.md, the GTM context file every other plugin in this stack reads before producing output.
